info.name: MetroViz
info.description:
Nextcloud-native successor to MetroViz by Ralf Stockmann (https://github.com/rstockm/Metroviz). MetroViz visualises technology roadmaps as metro maps — lines are themes, stations are milestones.
The rendering core is the upstream's, integrated here with Nextcloud Files: `.metro` files live in the user's NC home, double-clicking one in the Files app opens the viewer fullscreen (via OCA\Viewer), sharing flows through the standard NC share dialog, and storage is pure WebDAV.
No external services, no analytics, no CDN. MIT-licensed, matching the upstream's licence.
info.author: Bodo Steffen
